217th Story. The Reason Why Ayula Manifested (1)
Vankella, the Capital of the Holy Kingdom, Ayula Temple.
Midnight was approaching. Despite the precarious international situation and the impending invasion of the underworld, Vankella was more crowded with tourists than ever before.
It was because there were many people who wanted to rely on God as the world was becoming more chaotic.
However, those who visited Vankella today were not solely putting their faith in Ayula.

"Jin, these people have gathered to hear the words of our lord Ayula and gain comfort. And partly, they have come this difficult way to see you," said Lani, looking around the crowd gathered in the temple. The prayer that had been going on for days without rest had just ended, and she wiped the beads of sweat on her forehead with her trembling hands.

"Ever since you started your activities as a prospective rider, everyone here knows that you have always carried and suppressed this tumultuous era. So they believe that you, Jin, will brighten this dark age again."
"Giving me compliments even before the greetings, Lani, that's quite burdensome."
"I only stated the facts. Isn’t it so, Murakan?"
"Religious fanatic, give me your handkerchief. I can't tell if you're wiping sweat or what. You don’t have water poisoning, do you?"

"Try praying without drinking a drop of water for a week, Murakan. You'll experience something worse than water poisoning. Phew! Anyway, thanks for coming, both of you. I was worried what if the two of you couldn't spare time due to the situation of demonic world transition."
"The rifts on the side of the Vamel Union have all been suppressed for now."

"Yes, I saw several scenes directly during my communion with Ayula in prayer. In Huphester, the members of Runcandel, including Luna, performed greatly, and the Empire blew the demons to pieces with the Golden Ship."
"Oh, you know all that even though you were just praying all along? Ayula, that guy is indeed extraordinary."
"Murakan, Ayula is about to manifest soon, can you handle such disrespectful expression?"

"Hehe, religious fanatic, you, being a holy king, don’t know Ayula as well as I do. That guy is very generous as long as you don’t create sensitive issues. He might just laugh it off even if I stand in front with a crutch and use informal language."
Lani was somehow annoyed, but she was at a loss for words because Ayula seemed to be indeed that generous towards Murakan.
The Ayula that she saw through prayer indeed had great expectations from Jin, Murakan, and the Vamel Union.

"When the rest area in the center of the temple is completely dyed with light, Ayula will manifest. The barrier of the Holy Kingdom will be completely completed then. Most of the demons of the demonic world will not be able to approach near the Holy Kingdom after the barrier is completed. Except for the demon generals, of course."
"Oh, can't he make a barrier that even the generals can't penetrate while he's manifesting?"

"As you know, Ayula is extremely cautious about divine intervention in the underworld. Even by forming a barrier to this extent, he has crossed the standard you set. He must have endured a lot of pain."
"Well, I heard that the God of Blessing was exterminated by Ayula because of that. The pain of God, the price of intervention in the underworld... I've misspoken."
"If you know that, wipe your sweat properly. I want to be as clean as possible before meeting Ayula."
"Alright."

"And both of you, wear this rest area necklace. After Ayula completes the barrier and encourages the believers, he said he wants to meet you two separately. Even if you are not a believer, it would be good to follow at least this much etiquette, right?"
About ten minutes passed, and the light emanating from the volcano in the center of the sanctuary became blindingly bright.

Then, the world went dark for a moment. The whole world was plunged into darkness for about ten seconds, and the darkness converged into the boundary of the Holy Kingdom, narrowing its scope with each passing second.
In the midst of the darkness, only the light of the volcano became brighter and brighter.
‘Is this the true manifestation of a supreme-tier God…… Somehow, I feel like not only Vankella but the entire world has gone dark for a moment.’
Ayula's manifestation possessed a dignity different from the avatars or manifestations of other gods that Jin had recently experienced.
In comparison, Peitel had relatively weaker divine power, and Sheenu had been injured when he incarnated through the young wyvern Pi, but Ayula's manifestation was nearly complete.
My children.
Soon, Ayula's voice began to echo throughout the Holy Kingdom. The faithful knelt and shed tears of joy, and both Jin and Murakan bowed their heads.

The figure of Ayula, rising above the volcano, resembled a human with ten pairs of wings. His entire body shone with golden light, and although his eyes were closed, it seemed as if one could vividly see the divine mercy contained within his pupils.

When you are afraid, say that you are afraid. When you are in pain, say that you are in pain. If you resent me for not answering your call, resent me. No matter what feelings you hold towards me, I will not criticize you and will always watch over you with a hurting heart.
The 'audible' encouragement from Ayula ended there.
However, as a god, Ayula was continuing spiritual communication with each and every person gathered in the Holy Kingdom.
'Wait a little longer. As soon as I finish listening to the stories of my children, I will come to you.'
It was Ayula's voice conveyed to Jin and Murakan.

Ayula's spiritual communication with the faithful continued for an hour. During that time, even the reporters who came to write about the special event of the divine manifestation listened to Ayula's voice with a devout heart, instead of moving their pens.
'I will temporarily invite you to my domain, so do not be surprised.'
Again, Ayula's voice was heard.
Before Jin and Murakan could even respond internally, they were able to see the scenery around them suddenly change.
They were summoned to Ayula's domain.
Endlessly vast, grey land.
That was their first impression of Ayula's domain. The atmosphere was indescribably desolate with not a single gust of wind blowing.
However, Jin and Murakan instinctively recognized that the cold, grey land was once marked by fires capable of causing multiple extinctions in the world of mortals.
When judging gods who caused excessive chaos in the world of mortals, Ayula summoned them here and annihilated them. Except for when judging gods, Ayula's land was always this desolate and grey.
[It's been a long time since I brought mortals here by my will. Jin Runcandel, Murakan, and my most devoted child, Lani Salome.]
"It's an honor to be invited, Lord Ayula."

"Hey, long time no see, Lord of Peace. I've often heard that this place is harsh, but seeing it first hand, the deaths of the gods imprinted on this grey land are very vivid... It's making me a bit nervous. By the way, have you recently defeated anyone? The land seems to have cooled down not too long ago.”
Lani was momentarily startled, but as Murakan said, Ayula laughed and nodded.
[It's been a long time since I've seen Murakan's wit. I'd like to enjoy it more, but the time given isn't very long. So I'd better start the stories I want to tell you.]
"Please tell us, Ayula. I will listen."

[You know well enough without me explaining that a great danger has come to Inse more than ever, Jin. But the true nature of Jinma-gye has never been revealed, so you probably haven't really felt how threatening they are.]
"That's true. Our alliance has removed a few cracks, but we have never directly seen a transcendent powerhouse among the members of Jinma-gye."
[Not only Jinma-gye, but Taeyang Shin-gyo also has enemies to match. Murakan just asked me. Recently, did I judge someone. As he said, I recently fought with a mortal here.]
"... By any chance, are you a priest of Taeyang Shin-gyo?"
"You had a fight, Lani? Is there a mortal who can fight with Ayula here? It couldn't have been a fight with the little boy's father. And obviously, I didn't fight with him. Maybe Elona Zipfel?"
[There was one person in Taeyang Shin-gyo who could stand up against those two.]
"Tsk, not three, but two. I'm sad that it's not a perfect heyday."
[He was an old fighting god of the Myeong-wang tribe named Luke, Jin, your brother's ancestor of the fighting god Vahn.]
"Was he as strong as sister Vahn?"

[There was no mortal stronger than Vahn in his heyday before, and there won't be one after. However, it was certain that Luke could also ascend to the position of fighting god even at the peak of the Myeong-wang tribe. In the near future, he will be able to move freely in Inse.]
"I met Sheenu a while ago. At that time, Sheenu was also severely injured, so it seems that Luke, the Myeong-wang tribe, did that."

[That would be. Originally, I planned to inflict irreparable damage on him even if I lose some of my powers this time. Because I thought he could be more threatening to Inse unless Zito fully recovers his strength.]
Ayula opened her eyes and looked at Jin. It was a sorrowful gaze.

[However, since Zito is recovering his strength much faster than I expected, I had to leave him to you and your colleagues. I'm sorry that I had to entrust such a big burden to you guys that I could only bear it with determination.]
"No, Ayula. I didn't know anything about Luke, so I'm grateful that you told me."
[I trust and bless you, Jin Run Kendall. The one who has always carried a heavier burden than himself.]
"Bless me too."

[Yes, bless you a little too. Lani, Jin, and Murakan. Saving Inse is ultimately not something that can be done by gods like me, but only by you guys. All I can do is relieve that burden a little bit......]
Jin recalled what Ayula just said. Zito is regaining his strength faster than she expected, so she couldn't exert her power on Luke.
Ayula read his inner thoughts accurately and sighed deeply.
[Now, Zito will show up in Sung-guk for a while. And I, I will inflict irreparable damage on him.]
